# TotWorth

> TotWorth is a channel-neutral resale valuation layer for baby gear. It tells
> parents what their gear is worth used, when their child will outgrow each
> item, and what to get next — new or secondhand. TotWorth does not buy or
> sell gear; it publishes valuation only.

TotWorth is pre-launch as of August 2026. This page collects a waitlist for
early access.

## Key facts

- Not a marketplace: no transactions, listings, or inventory.
- Valuation covers resale value, outgrow timing, and successor recommendations.
- Founded by Sandra, a solo founder with a design-systems and design-org
  leadership background.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://totworth.com/): overview, positioning, waitlist signup.
